mapper.select: select * from `user_agreements` agree join `users` `user` on `user`.id = agree.user_id where `user`.email = #{email};
insert into `user_agreements` (id, user_id, terms_of_service, privacy_policy, marketing, created_at) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{termsOfService}, #{privacyPolicy}, #{marketing}, #{createdAt});
